scenes.say: One single trade kills your account? Then it was too big.

scenes.text: Risk only 0.5 to 1% of your account per trade – never more.
scenes.say: The rule: risk only half a percent to one percent of your account per trade.

scenes.label: STEP 01 · Example
scenes.say: Step one: with a five thousand dollar account, one percent is fifty dollars.

scenes.title: STEP 02 · Calculate lot size
scenes.say: Step two: stop five dollars away. Then zero point one lot fits.

scenes.label: STEP 03 · Example
scenes.sub: 10 losses in a row at 1% – account survives.
scenes.say: Step three: even ten losses in a row only cost you about ten percent.

scenes.text: Picking the lot size first, then the stop. Always the other way round!
scenes.say: Common mistake: picking the lot size first. Stop comes first, then size.

scenes.title: No time to analyze the market *yourself*?
